text_block_list.text:
After our outing, the sun had completely 
set, and just as I was about to walk Rice 
Shower back to the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother... I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Could you wait for me in the trainer's 
office for just a little bit...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to show you, Big 
Brother...
choice_data_list: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to show you, Big 
Sister...
choice_data_list: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks! I'll be right there, just wait a 
little bit...!

What could it be that she wants to show 
me? I brew two cups of tea and wait—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Sorry to keep you waiting, Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Sorry to keep you waiting, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...This is what I wanted you to see.
Rice Shower held out a single book to me.

On the black cover, only a single sentence 
was written— "The Sun and the Shadow 
Child."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You see... it's a picture book Rice made. 
I'd really like... Big Brother to read it.
choice_data_list: I wonder if I can read it now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You see... it's a picture book Rice made. 
I'd really like... Big Sister to read it.
choice_data_list: I wonder if I can read it now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

Open the picture book in front of her 
smiling face.

There were no words in that picture book. 
It begins, at first, in pitch-black 
darkness.

At the center of that darkness crouched a 
black figure. Its silhouette bore a 
striking resemblance—to Rice Shower.

The black figure wept in the darkness. So 
sorrowfully, so lonely...

Suddenly, a thin ray of light pierced the 
darkness. The black shadow began walking 
toward the source of the light.

As the black figure pressed forward, the 
light grew stronger and increasingly 
dazzling, until finally—

“—The light turns into the sun. The 
darkness clears, illuminating the world.”

Illuminated by the warm light of the sun, 
the black figure regained its true form 
that had been lost in the dark.

She joyfully gallops across a world bathed 
in light—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...This picture book... I wanted to show 
it to Big Brother first.
choice_data_list: I'm honored to be the very first.
I'm honored to be the very first.

It was a picture book that made me feel so 
happy.
I want to be like this sun.
I want to be like this sun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...This picture book... I wanted to show 
it to Big Sister first.
choice_data_list: I'm honored to be the very first.
I'm honored to be the very first.

It was a picture book that made me feel so 
happy.
I want to be like this sun.
I want to be like this sun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...You're always right by Rice's side, 
watching over me so gently and warmly."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice just wanted to show Onii-sama... how 
she truly feels.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice just wanted to show Onee-sama... how 
she truly feels.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice's precious, precious happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Please keep watching over Rice... forever 
and always, okay?

When I give her a firm nod, she smiles 
back, looking truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Because this picture book— is a tangible 
form of the happiness Rice feels."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That means Rice's happiness has reached 
you too, Big Brother.
choice_data_list:
You can share that happiness with so many 
more people.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That means Rice's happiness has reached 
you too, Big Sister.
choice_data_list:
You can share that happiness with so many 
more people.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, you see— I want to make 
everyone who cheers for me happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, you know... I want to make 
everyone who cheers for me happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Making this book has made those feelings, 
that dream, grow bigger and bigger inside 
Rice."
choice_data_list: I want to support Rice's dream
I want to support Rice's dream

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If it's with you, dear brother, 
surely—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If it's with you, dear sister, 
surely—

I will make her dream come true, no matter 
what. I swore that vow deep in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother, ever since way back then...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister has, for a long time now...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —You're the sun to Rice, you know?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This picture book, you see... is because 
Big Brother cheered for Rice and believed 
in me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This picture book, you see... is because 
Big Sister cheered for Rice and believed 
in me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, Rice was able to change 
little by little... I feel like I was able 
to...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I made it by carefully recalling each and 
every one of those happy moments.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, as always, Brother.
choice_data_list: Next time, Rice will be everyone's sun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, as always, Sister.
choice_data_list: Next time, Rice will be everyone's sun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice is... everyone's sun?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I want to aim for it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
To shine on everyone... to bring happiness 
to everyone... I'll become the sun—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice wants to become one...!
choice_data_list: Let's make that dream come true together.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ――Yeah!

I witnessed the moment a dream, dazzling 
like the sun, took root in Rice Shower's 
eyes—
